[NSTG.5.3.4] **`identity_slot_name` and `identity_value`
both empty** indicates a `by: none` series (one global
allocation per `(schema, slot, module)` per [LSER.7.6.2]).
Backends with named columns can route this to a special
"global" key; backends labelling by identity fold the
empty values into a `total` aggregation.
